visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a modern hotel room, showcasing a dark brown television console, a sleek yellow and black cabinet, and light-colored wooden flooring. (2) A medium shot displays two twin beds pushed together with crisp white linens and bright yellow decorative pillows against a dark headboard with integrated lighting. (3) A brief wide shot shows an expansive, high-ceilinged hotel lobby with industrial-style lighting and lush indoor greenery. (4) Back in the room, a young woman wearing a beige hoodie and dark pants walks through the spacious hallway of the suite. (5) The woman is then seen kneeling on the floor, fully opening a large suitcase to demonstrate the ample floor space available in the room. (6) A shot features a comfortable seating area with a light-colored sofa, patterned wall art, and a small black side table. (7) The woman is shown sitting on the sofa, holding a remote control and relaxing in the space. (8) The camera pans to a modern bathroom vanity with a large circular LED mirror and various toiletries organized on the counter. (9) A close-up shows the woman checking her appearance in the well-lit circular mirror. (10) A hand opens a door to reveal a separate, compact toilet room equipped with a modern Japanese washlet. (11) A wide shot of the bathing area shows a deep white bathtub and a minimalist shower setup in a separate room. (12) The woman opens the yellow cabinet to reveal a mini-fridge, bottled water, and a capsule coffee machine with supplies. (13) A low-angle shot captures a large common lounge area with soft, rounded seating pods and dim, atmospheric lighting. (14) Static promotional images show a luxurious indoor public bath and a swimming pool facility. (15) The woman is seen waving cheerfully while sitting on a bean bag in a bright, sun-drenched common area of the hotel. (16) A wide shot shows a colorful children's playroom with safe mats, toys, and playful architectural elements. (17) The woman is seen exiting through a door that leads directly into a FamilyMart convenience store connected to the hotel lobby. (18) A close-up shot of the bedside table shows a glass lamp with bubbles and the clean aesthetic of the room's interior design. (19) An exterior shot of the hotel building identifies it as the Tokyo Bay Shiomi Prince Hotel. (20) The video transitions to a screen recording of the HafH mobile application, detailing subscription plans and coin rewards. (21) The final shot returns to the hotel room with text prompting viewers to leave a comment for more information.
